source.version: main snapshot reviewed 2026-07-21; no tagged release

capabilities.title: Guide UI implementation and review with detailed animation, interaction, and visual-polish rules
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Translated the accepted motion rules into a project-owned contract; Nexus visual identity remains authoritative.

capabilities.title: Decide whether an interaction should animate based on frequency and purpose before choosing motion
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The pure gate evaluates frequency, purpose, input mode, and surface before assigning a duration budget.

capabilities.title: Review animations against explicit easing, duration, property, accessibility, and performance rules
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The focused gate rejects high-confidence broad-transition anti-patterns and preserves reduced-motion proof.

capabilities.title: Recon and audit interactive UI across multiple motion categories with evidence-backed severity
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus uses a deterministic active non-RPG scan for high-confidence patterns instead of claiming subjective automated review of every animation category.

capabilities.title: Pause after vetted findings, then write implementation plans only for selected items
capabilities.reason: Nexus already uses specs/features, tasks/todo.md, and explicit task authorization; a parallel design-plan store would duplicate authority.

capabilities.title: Find places where motion could improve comprehension or delight
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not run ambient opportunity generation; motion is added only for a requested feature or confirmed usability problem.

capabilities.title: Map vague motion descriptions to precise animation terms
capabilities.reason: A full external glossary would add documentation surface without improving the bounded project-owned gate.

capabilities.title: Translate responsive, physical, interruptible, and reduced-motion interaction principles to web interfaces
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Accepted principles are expressed as property scoping, short budgets, interaction-frequency limits, and reduced-motion preservation.

capabilities.title: Recommend UI libraries based on interaction and product needs
capabilities.reason: Nexus already has an established React, Tailwind, and component stack; automatic library selection would introduce unnecessary dependencies.

capabilities.title: Install the full Markdown skill collection through the cross-host skills CLI
capabilities.reason: The useful rules are project-owned and verified, so Nexus does not need to bulk-install the external pack.
